I do feel like it does cause a little bit of tangles during shampooing but I tend to use a brush when I use conditioner anyways so that takes care of the problem.

reviews.t: I bought 2 sets and will buy more!

You use less product and your hair feels cleaner than just washing/conditioning with your hands.  Highly highly recommend. I plan on buying more sets to gift to my friends.

He tends to get flakiness during low humidity (winter mostly) and this has kept him from getting any flare-ups.  I highly recommend this product!  Just be careful with it in the shower. My kids are awful at putting shampoo in their hair, they just kinda

I also tried it out with my dog when I gave her a bath and did a great job getting all the dirt out as well as shedding hair. Definitely recommend.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the product for leaving their scalp and hair feeling cleaner after washing.
Many users describe the bristles as soft and massage-like, making it comfortable to use on the scalp.
Several reviewers report improvements in scalp conditions such as dryness, flakiness, dandruff, and itchiness.
Some users mention reduced hair shedding or noticeable new hair growth/thickness after regular use.
Reviewers frequently highlight the good value, especially for the two-pack, and note it works as well as pricier brands.

qa.q: Is it soft enough for sensitive scalps?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer with a sensitive scalp says using it can feel uncomfortable and they must be careful due to easy migraines [2], while another says it is not painful at all and slides smoothly over the head [5].

claims.text: A reviewer with a sensitive scalp says the brush can feel uncomfortable and they must be careful because they get migraines easily.
Another reviewer says the brush is not painful at all and slides smoothly over the head.

qa.q: Does it work well on thick or long hair?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it works well on long and/or thick hair [2][3], while others report tangling with long hair [4][6].

claims.text: It works well on long and/or thick hair without tangling or pulling it out.
It tangled the hair of a reviewer with long hair and caused some tangles during shampooing.

qa.q: Will it get tangled or pull my hair?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it does not tangle or pull hair [1], while others report tangling during shampooing [2] or that it kept tangling their long hair [3]. One reviewer with curly hair found it did not add to tangles when used gently [4].

claims.text: One reviewer was afraid it would tangle or pull out her hair but says it does neither [1].
Another reviewer feels it causes a little bit of tangles during shampooing [2].
A reviewer with long hair says it kept tangling up her hair [3].
A reviewer using it gently on curly hair says it doesn't add to tangles [4].

qa.q: Is it easy to clean and does it dry quickly?
qa.answer: Reviews say it is easy to clean, with one noting essentially zero maintenance to clean after use [2]. However, no review addresses whether it dries quickly.

claims.text: It is easy to clean and requires essentially zero maintenance to clean after use.

qa.q: Is it durable and does it hold up in the shower?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate it works well in the shower, with one noting no space for water to get inside and cause mold [5], though another warns to be careful in the shower because the plastic outer part could break [3]. Durability is not otherwise directly addressed.

claims.text: There isn't any space for water to get inside and make it moldy [5].
Be careful with it in the shower because the outer plastic part could break [3].
